summary.text: Matt Schlinker is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Rep. David Martin.
A retired auto worker and Genesee County native, he said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he is running to take the people's principles to Lansing.

paragraphs.text: Matt Schlinker graduated from Flint Northern High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as quality engineer.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father, and grandfather.
In the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary he defeated Isaiah Grays with 67.4% of the vote.
Schlinker's three campaign messages were making Michigan more affordable, protecting public schools, students, and teachers, and making government more honest and transparent.

He said he is passionate about supporting union jobs and collective bargaining rights, well-funded public schools and career and vocational training, and campaign finance reform and FOIA transparency for state government.
